content.short: PrimeXBT offers Crypto and CFD trading with web and mobile platforms, including Crypto Futures and Copy Trading.
content.description: PrimeXBT, founded in 2018, serves a diverse global community in more than 150 countries. The platform focuses on Crypto and CFD trading and offers a broad range of web and mobile interfaces designed to meet the needs of traders at every level. Its ecosystem features Crypto Futures, Copy Trading, and Global Market trading across Forex, Commodities, Stock Indices, and Cryptocurrencies, providing access to a wide spectrum of assets and markets for active participants across the globe.
content.meta: PrimeXBT focuses on empowering traders with innovative global trading products since 2018. Discover PrimeXBT and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
